description: An `outcomeTo` naming a destination outside $ui fails validation as BINDING_PATH_INVALID. An outcome is page-scoped bookkeeping that is never persisted (UIS-104); a destination inside the bound resource would let a transient refusal be written back to the server as if it were part of the record.

errors.message: "saveOutcome" is not a legal outcome destination — it must name $ui.<name>[.<name>…] (UIS-166)
